newsitem.title: JAPAN: INSIGHT-JGBs seen top-heavy ahead benchmark shift.
newsitem.headline: INSIGHT-JGBs seen top-heavy ahead benchmark shift.

text.p: FUTURE RANGE/DAY SPPRT RSTNC RSI-9 MA-5 MA-25
OUTLOOK OF BOJ OPERATION AT 0020 GMT: injection of 100 bln
*JGBs likely to be range-bound and top-heavy, with shift to September benchmark certain on Wednesday after volume of September higher than that of June in overnight London trade.
*Market will be watching moves of Japanese stocks after strong trade earlier this week, with any rise in the Nikkei 225 to near 21,000 points putting bonds under downward pressure.
